title: Replace dataRequirements with typed payload interfaces
description: WHY: registry entries declare their data with a stringly-typed mini-schema (requirement(blockerIds, array, true, ...) in packages/core/src/agent-directive-registry.ts lines 68-77 and siblings), which is a third representation alongside the TS types and schemas/directives JSON schema - three places to drift. WHAT: give each directive (equivalently each gap code) a typed payload interface in TS as the single source, generate or derive the JSON schema from those types (or validate fixtures against hand-written schema in CI so drift fails the build), and delete the requirement() helper and its runtime checking in the compiler. The gap payloads defined in sprint 2 task one should already be these types; this task aligns the registry side to consume them directly.
acceptanceCriteria: requirement() helper and dataRequirements arrays are deleted from the registry
Each gap code has one TS payload type consumed by both emitter and registry, with schema drift covered by a CI test
closedReason: Typed payload contract migration complete and verified.
